semantic_texts.0000: Normal operating condition in a three-phase power transmission system. No ground fault and no phase fault are present; phase currents and voltages remain balanced.
semantic_texts.1001: Single line-to-ground fault involving phase A and ground in a three-phase power transmission system. The fault causes abnormal phase-A current and voltage distortion relative to phases B and C.
semantic_texts.0110: Line-to-line fault between phases B and C in a three-phase power transmission system. The fault produces coupled current and voltage abnormalities on phases B and C without direct ground involvement.
semantic_texts.1011: Double line-to-ground fault involving phases A and B with ground in a three-phase power transmission system. The fault combines inter-phase coupling with a ground path.
semantic_texts.0111: Three-phase line fault involving phases A, B, and C without ground in a three-phase power transmission system. The fault produces coupled current and voltage abnormalities across all three phases without a ground-current path.
semantic_texts.1111: Three-phase-to-ground fault involving phases A, B, C and ground in a three-phase power transmission system. This severe fault produces broad current surges and voltage collapse across all phases.
